title: agent-incident/1
description: Incident record schema for coding agent bug reports. Produced by watchdog tools (Loopbreaker, etc.) and consumed by AgentRepro to collect evidence bundles. Unknown optional fields MUST be ignored. Unknown major version MUST be rejected.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for this document.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this incident schema. Current: '1.0'.

incident_id.description: Globally unique opaque identifier for this incident. Generated by the producer.

source.description: Information about the producer and the agent session.

producer.description: Tool that created this incident record, e.g. 'loopbreaker', 'agentrepro', 'manual'.

agent.description: Coding agent that was being monitored, e.g. 'claude-code', 'codex-cli', 'opencode'.

agent_version.description: Version string of the monitored agent.

session_ref.description: Local opaque reference to the agent's session. NOT the session contents — the consumer resolves this reference.

detector.description: Information about the detection that triggered this incident.

rule.description: Name or identifier of the detection rule that fired.

threshold.description: Threshold value that the rule uses for comparison.

observed.description: Observed value that exceeded the threshold.

detected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the incident was detected.

session_started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent session started (if known).

session_ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent session ended (if known).

evidence_refs.description: References to additional evidence produced by the detector.

path.description: Local filesystem path or opaque reference.

severity.description: Severity level assigned by the producer.
